objective: P6 Stage 1b-dense (measurement, promotion-only): on liquid US stocks (L12) with DoltHub volatility_history, measure the daily industry- and beta-neutral rank-IC decay of four preregistered option-implied signals (IVRV, DIV21, DIV5, IVZ3) and promote to the P1 Stage 2a signal family those with significant recent-window implementable information.

sources.core_claim: Bali and Hovakimian (Management Science 55(11) 2009): the realized-minus-implied volatility spread is negatively related to expected stock returns (volatility-risk proxy); the call-minus-put implied volatility spread is positively related (jump-risk proxy).
sources.project_applicability: Fixes the IVRV direction: long stocks whose implied volatility is high relative to realized volatility (iv - RV21 positive). Corrects the reversed direction in I-20261005-03 and the T-20260929-61 plan.
sources.reflection: Abstract only (full text not obtained); sample 1996-2004; NYSE stocks per OSAP notes.

sources.core_claim: Open Source Asset Pricing signal documentation: RIVolSpread = realized vol (past 30 days) minus ATM implied vol, Sign -1, port-sort t 2.9 (return 0.732%/month), 1996-2004; dVolCall sign +1 (t 3.45), dVolPut sign -1 (t 2.03), dCPVolSpread sign -1 (t 6.77).
sources.project_applicability: Independent confirmation of the IVRV sign and the size reference for the power section (IC21 about 0.018-0.026 after T-36c's conversion).
sources.reflection: In-sample replication of the original periods; no post-2011 numbers. Snapshot is a verbatim field extract of the T-36c OSAP SignalDoc rows (the raw JSON contains '<' filter strings that the quote checker strips).

sources.core_claim: An, Ang, Bali and Cakici (JF 2014): stocks with large increases in call implied volatility over the previous month have high future returns and stocks with large increases in put implied volatility have low future returns; decile spreads about 1% per month that persist.
sources.project_applicability: Motivates DIV21 and DIV5; because DoltHub's iv_current blends calls and puts, whose changes predict with opposite signs, the direction is taken from the stress window instead of the paper.
sources.reflection: 1996-2011 OptionMetrics, separate call and put surfaces at delta 0.5 and 30 days; our IV is a vendor blend of unknown construction.

sources.core_claim: Muravyev, Pearson and Pollet (working paper 2022, JFE 2025): option-signal stock return predictability decreases by about two-thirds after returns are adjusted for borrow fees, and by a similar amount if high-fee stocks are excluded.
sources.project_applicability: Lowers the priors; L12 names are mostly low-fee, so the measured IC is expected near the post-fee third of the published effect.
sources.reflection: Sample 2006-07..2015-08; working-paper version read, published version not obtained.

sources.core_claim: Neuhierl, Tang, Varneskov and Zhou (Management Science 72(4) 2026): option information matters, but only a few option characteristics have significant incremental predictive power after controlling for a large set of firm characteristics; the strongest relate to mispricing, tail returns and short-selling costs.
sources.project_applicability: Makes the marginal IC against m0_composite and the nine themes a required diagnostic and lowers the prior that a promoted signal adds book-level Sharpe.
sources.reflection: Abstract only; which characteristics survive is not stated in the abstract.

sources.core_claim: Walter, Zimmer and Ulrich (arXiv 2609.31263, 2026-09-25): 137 option-implied characteristics for optionable US stocks 2004-2023, screened to 20 factors and tested against 160 equity factors; equity factors explain about 91% of option-factor variance; 4 factors survive Bonferroni (IV convexity, two jump-tail measures, risk-neutral kurtosis); in-sample only.
sources.project_applicability: IV-RV and IV changes are not among the survivors, so priors are lowered; the surviving dimensions need the full smile, which only the T-20261005-33 recorder can provide.
sources.reflection: In-sample, no hold-out; read through the fetch tool's extraction of the HTML full text.

sources.core_claim: Measured by the 13:07 lead round on 2026-10-05 through the DoltHub SQL API: volatility_history has rows on 594 of 674 NYSE sessions in 2024-01-08..2026-09-15 and 485 of 490 from 2024-10-01, median 1,535 symbols per covered date; Mon/Wed/Fri only before 2024-09; rows also on 27 holidays; date d is committed about 06:35 UTC the next calendar day; delisted names (TWTR, SIVB, FRC, ATVI, XLNX, ...) appear in 2021 under their tickers of the time.
sources.project_applicability: Sets the data gate thresholds (F1, F2) and the power section; point-in-time symbols remove the survivorship concern for the stress window.
sources.reflection: Vendor and snapshot time undocumented; commit times only cover the live era.

sources.core_claim: T-36c (I-20261005-03): the forward recorder alone gives a minimum detectable IC21 of 0.117 at 200 names x 60 days versus published 0.007-0.033; the DoltHub dense segment (about 1,000 names x 520 days) gives about 0.018 under pure sampling noise; it recommended IV spread, IV minus RV and monthly IV change.
sources.project_applicability: Defines the route this contract takes; its IV-minus-RV direction is corrected here (the paper's sign is the opposite).
sources.reflection: Pure-sampling-noise power; time variation in the true IC makes the real MDE larger.
